notes: B-106 (gate R5-14), the step boundary. Printed: 'Whenever one or more Cats you control deal combat damage to a player, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment that player controls.' The Kitty has first strike, so it deals its damage in the first-strike combat damage step and the Sovereign in the regular one (CR 510.4): two combat damage events, one trigger each (once per combat damage step, not once per combat). The first destroys the Relic, the second the Charm. Seat 1 takes 2 + 2 (20 -> 16).
